card.name: Separators inside symptom lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', and an opening parenthesis right after a listed symptom or drug name, where another item in the list comes next. Seen in side-effect, overdose and urge lists.

modes.label: Comma after list item
modes.description: A comma after a symptom or urge in a list of effects.
modes.example: patients can experience intense urges to gamble<<,>> increased sexual urges, intense urges to spend

modes.label: 'or' joining items
modes.description: The word 'or' between the last two items of a symptom or behavior list.
modes.example: Advise patients to avoid becoming dehydrated<< or>> overheated ( 5.1 ).

modes.label: Parenthesis after drug name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a drug name in a list of related drugs, introducing an alternate name.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a list of symptoms or drugs where the next item is about to start.
